race.comment: GOODNIGHT JASPER (1) goes very well this course and distance starting 11 times for five wins and three minors. Below best last time at this track (26.12) in a Special conditions race, finishing a 7 length seventh. Looks suited and should go close. GRAPEFRUIT EXPEL (2) finished in the minors last time but only a few starts back pushed the clock when winning over 515m at Launceston, taking a Other in a fast 29.79. Expecting another bold showing. GUS THE JET (6) was safely held in tougher company last start at this track, but prior to that won by 0.8 lengths at this track (25.95) beating Lochinvar Angel in a Grade 4/5 on September 17. Comes out of a hot form race last start. Worth another chance. MOTORSPORT (4) is in winning form and worth including in the main hopes.
